item.title: Gaels Dominate Nipissing 81-56 in Convincing Home Win
item.description: The Queen's Gaels women's basketball team defeated the Nipissing Lakers 81-56 in a convincing home game. The Gaels showcased sharp shooting, tough defence, and balanced scoring to take control of the game from start to finish.

item.title: Queen's Men's Hockey Head Coach Brett Gibson honoured at Carr-Harris Cup for 500 games with Gaels
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey Head Coach Brett Gibson was honoured at a pre-game ceremony ahead of the Carr-Harris Cup for reaching the 500 games coached milestone with the Gaels.

item.title: Gaels Secure a Huge 111-69 Home Victory Against Nipissing
item.description: The Queen's Gaels men's basketball team dominated the Nipissing Lakers on Friday, February 6, securing a huge 111-69 home victory. The Gaels showcased sharp shooting, relentless defence, and a balanced offensive attack to control the game from start to finish.

item.title: Queen's Men's Volleyball drop road contest to Varsity Blues
item.description: Queen's Men's Volleyball closed out their regular season with a 3-1 (18-25, 25-18, 25-14, 25-20) loss to the Toronto Varsity Blues in Toronto, Ont. Saturday afternoon.

item.title: GAELS SWEEP VARSITY BLUES, EXTEND WIN STREAK TO NINE
item.description: The Queen's Gaels swept the Toronto Varsity Blues in three straight sets on Saturday afternoon on the road. Coming off last night's four-set win, the Gaels brought intensity into today's game early. Queen's improves their record to 13-5 and extends their winning streak to nine games, as they near the end of the regular season. item.description: Queen's Football is defending the Yates Cup in 2026; make sure you're along for the ride!

item.title: Gaels Secures 77-69 Win Against Laurentian at Home
item.description: The Queen's Gaels men's basketball team secured a 77-69 home victory over the Laurentian Voyageurs on Saturday, February 7, using steady offensive execution and consistent defensive pressure to control the game.

item.title: Gaels Top Laurentian 86-49 in Home Victory
item.description: The Queen's Gaels women's basketball team delivered a dominant performance at home on Saturday, February 7, defeating the Laurentian Voyageurs 86-49. Strong defence, efficient shooting, and balanced scoring allowed the Gaels to take control early and maintain their lead throughout the game.

item.title: Milestone Goals Fuel Queen’s 8–1 Victory Over Windsor.
item.description: Queen's Women's Hockey returned to home ice Saturday afternoon for a cross-division showdown against the Windsor Lancers, with the Gaels celebrating several special milestones alongside the on-ice action. Sara Di Filippo (Concurrent Education) skated in her 100th career game in the tricolour, while Rebecca Thompson was honoured with the Kingston Red Baron Award, recognizing her leadership on and off the ice, academic excellence, strong character, and dedication to the Kingston community.
